priorE0Explanation: P2-E0 recorded that an OPTIONAL providerRetryPolicy method caused the activation failure. MEASURED FALSE.

measuredRootCauses.symptom: TypeError: adapter.providerRetryPolicy is not a function; cordis: 1 entry did not activate
measuredRootCauses.fix: declare providerRetryPolicy(provider) returning undefined (runtime applies its own default)

measuredRootCauses.what: adapter method signatures and return shapes were wrong
measuredRootCauses.where: normalizeModelInfo validates resolveModel(provider,model,signal) => {provider,id,name}; prepareCall must resolve to {model,stream}
measuredRootCauses.symptom: adapterCall.model was undefined; the turn never dispatched a stream
measuredRootCauses.fix: implement the exact measured signatures and shapes

measuredRootCauses.what: the worker scope presents PTC, so only run_code is directly callable
measuredRootCauses.where: dsh-tools registry refusal recorded in the persisted session tool/result
measuredRootCauses.symptom: Error: unknown tool "palimpsest_worker_result": only run_code is callable directly
measuredRootCauses.fix: emit one run_code call whose program invokes the result tool as await tools[name](args)

measuredRootCauses.what: the adapter emitted the tool call on every stream, so the turn never concluded
measuredRootCauses.where: agent loop re-invokes the adapter after each tool result
measuredRootCauses.symptom: unbounded stream invocations until the wall clock killed the worker
measuredRootCauses.fix: after a tool result is present, emit a final text answer instead of another call

hostFailureLineNote: the runner still prints {kind:HOST_FAILURE,detail} on the same PALIMPSEST_WORK_RESULT prefix; that is a HOST fact, not a worker outcome. The real defect was the adapter never producing a worker outcome at all, so this is now moot for the deterministic path, but the prefix sharing remains a latent collision and is reported as such rather than silently changed.
